title: converged fit on a pixel-integral frame + retained point-sampled failure

frozen_inputs.frame: 9x9 TAN, CRVAL=(10,20) deg, CRPIX=(5,5), CD=0.001 deg/pix
frozen_inputs.positive_image: generated by evaluate_psf of a frozen EffectivePSF with sigma=1.2 (the same pixel-integral model as the fitter), unit total flux 100
frozen_inputs.retained_image: point-sampled Gaussian at pixel centres (outside the model family)
frozen_inputs.fit: gaussian family, spatial degree 0, window radius 3, tolerance 1e-8 / 512 iterations

diagnosis: the point-sampled frame is outside the pixel-integral model family (a model mismatch, not an iteration-cap defect); the same fitter converges on the exact integrated frame and reports nonconverged on the sampled one at 1e-8. A looser 1e-4 score tolerance accepts the sampled frame.
